answer: The velvet schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the basalt checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 64 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. Someone wanting 61 effective identities must lock that capital for 64 epochs and keep it locked through every gale audit. That is 19 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
